rationale: Equinix's current NY4 page identifies the exact facility code and 755 Secaucus Road address and publishes active products, support, security, power, and cooling specifications. Its 151,771-square-foot figure is explicitly colocation space, so it is retained as context rather than total building area.

Official New Albany planning records and independent reporting establish active AWS data-center development and operation in the Beech Road area, while a directory labels CMH56 operational. None of the reviewed sources maps the CMH56 code to this exact building with a second accepted identifier, so campus and directory evidence cannot establish the building's lifecycle status.

TierPoint's current Charlotte Center Park page identifies CL4 at 1805 Center Park Drive, marks capacity available, and publishes active managed services, remote hands, security, and uptime specifications. The 60,000-plus-square-foot figure is a lower bound and is retained as context rather than normalized as an exact building-area observation.

Digital Realty's current PHX15 page identifies the exact 2121 South Price Road facility and offers active space, compliance, and 24x7 security. Its 508,000-square-foot value is explicitly total building size and is accepted as a facility observation.

QTS's current Piscataway 1 page and its DC1 data sheet identify 101 Possumtown Road and publish active facility, tour, security, connectivity, and power information. The data sheet's 360,000-square-foot facility value is accepted; the page's campus and expansion capacity figures are not allocated to the mapped building.

Official New Albany records and independent reporting establish AWS data-center activity in the Beech Road area, while a directory associates CMH59 with 2560 Beech Road. The reviewed evidence does not independently confirm the CMH59 building-code mapping or current status with a second accepted identifier, so the record remains unresolved.

Csquare's current TPA1 specification sheet identifies the exact facility code and 9310 Florida Palm Drive address and publishes active support, security, network, and capacity specifications. Florida's January 20, 2016 state impact-conference inventory lists the CenturyLink Tampa data center with the facility's 33619 location, capacity, and contemporaneous operator page, supplying a conservative operational-no-later-than event. Cyxtera remains a historical seed label; the current operator is Csquare.

H5 Data Centers' current Phoenix page identifies the exact 2600 West Germann Road facility, active customer and connectivity services, and a 100% uptime track record. Its 180,000-square-foot facility size and 26 MW capacity are accepted as exact-facility observations.
